text:
Olivia (Support): customer BrightLens says a bunch of objects with a 30d custom retention are still searchable after 45 days, wants urgent removal + audit. IDs: obj_3f9a, obj_7b2c, obj_9d10. KMS key: key-prod-04. Can we triage?
Sam (SRE): sorry — can you confirm the exact API call they used and whether they set `retention_mode` vs `ttl`? also share the earliest affected timestamp.
Olivia (Support): they used list API via our dashboard export and the SDK call below, earliest create: 2024-06-18 14:32 UTC. SDK snippet they ran:```
GET /v1/objects?filter=policy:custom_30d&created_before=2024-07-24
Authorization: Bearer <cust-token>
```
Raj (Infra): checking infra logs now. I see a background retention migration job for flag migration on 2024-07-20 that failed for several shards due to KMS Decrypt errors around 2024-07-20 03:12 UTC. Pasting relevant log snippet:```
2024-07-20T03:12:05Z ERROR retention-migrator shard-12 failed to update retention_flag for obj_3f9a; kms:DecryptionFailure key=key-prod-04 requestId=abc123
```
Nikita (Security): if the migrator couldn't decrypt metadata it could have left objects in a legacy-visible state. Do we have audit log entries for admin-modify-retention on those objects? If not, that suggests the updater never completed.
Olivia (Support): customer says they didn't call any admin modify APIs. They only saw items in results. No explicit legal hold was applied by customer.
Kate (Legal): BrightLens has an active litigation hold request submitted yesterday. We need a forensic export of access & admin logs for the object IDs and the KMS key activity for 2024-07-19..2024-07-21. Also need confirmation that objects won't be deleted until hold cleared.
Raj (Infra): understood. I'm starting an export. Quick command for audit-team (will run ASAP):```
redwood audit export --start 2024-07-19 --end 2024-07-21 --objects obj_3f9a,obj_7b2c,obj_9d10 --events admin.modify,object.read,kms.decrypt --outfile /tmp/brightlens-audit-0719-21.ndjson
```
Raj (Infra): also found a failed job id migr-20240720-7, pushing it into retry queue now. If retry succeeds, retention_flag should be applied and objects become non-searchable per policy. I'll monitor.
Sam (SRE): what's the fallback if retry fails due to KMS key state? we might need to re-run with a rotated-key path or request KMS assist. @Nikita any constraints on temporarily pausing delete?
Nikita (Security): legal hold supersedes deletion — we'll mark these objects as on-hold in the control plane to prevent automated purges. Raj, pause the migrator retries for these shards until we confirm export completeness.
Raj (Infra): paused retries for migr-20240720-7 on shards 12/13. Continuing export now.
Olivia (Support): I've opened escalation CS-8214 and notified the customer that we're pausing deletion and performing a fast export. Customer asked for ETA.
Sam (SRE): tentative ETA: audit export + KMS activity log correlation in 2-4 hours. If migrator retry succeeds sooner we'll update.
Kate (Legal): confirm once export delivered to legal S3 and include checksum. We'll triage hold paperwork then.
ops-bot: reminder: incident policy applied: priority=high, sla=4h. Ticket CS-8214 assigned to Olivia, Raj, Sam, Nikita.
Olivia (Support): copying summary to BrightLens legal: "We found a failed retention migration tied to KMS Decrypt errors on 2024-07-20. We've paused automated deletes and started audit export. We'll deliver logs and next steps within the SLA."
Sam (SRE): will follow up here when migrator retry result is in or export finishes.
Raj (Infra): export started, 14% done (objects+events ~ small). logs and KMS traces will be zipped to s3://redwood-legal-exports/brightlens/brightlens-0719-21.zip when complete.
Nikita (Security): once zip ready, share presigned URL to Kate and OpsSec. I'll run KMS key usage correlation next.
Olivia (Support): thanks team. customer acknowledged pause and appreciates speed.
Sam (SRE): update: migrator retry completed successfully at 1719802875 (2024-07-20T04:01:15Z) for the three objects. Retention flags now present in metadata; search results should hide them within next few minutes after index refresh.
Olivia (Support): customer confirms objects are now not appearing in search UI. Marking initial issue as mitigated pending export delivery.
Kate (Legal): received export, checksum OK, holding direction noted. Will coordinate with customer counsel.
ops-bot: ticket CS-8214 status -> mitigated; still open for postmortem (owner: Sam).
